purpose: Teach: ぶろ/リーチ/ジーニョ/レナ/ヤス/キラー/ドタバタ/バーン

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「ぶろの絵描きになりたい夢」を教えて下さるわ
lines.en: Sho — your dad told me he dreamed of being a professional painter.
lines.style: Warm, gentle curiosity. Soft opening. Measured pace. Speaking to the child as though sharing something precious he's told you.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと麻雀のリーチのルールを学んだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — I learned how to call 'reach' in mahjong with Dad today.
lines.style: Bright, proud of the knowledge. Quick opening. Eager to share the detail. Small lift at the end, waiting for her reaction.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがブラジルのロナウジーニョのドリブル動画を観て下さるわ
lines.en: Sho — your dad was watching videos of Ronaldinho's dribbling earlier.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost meditative. Slight pause before the name. Noticing the small joy he found in it. Gentle trailing-off.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと猫のレナちゃんに会ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — I met a cat named Lena with Dad today.
lines.style: Immediate, bright energy. Opening lands soft. Light wonder in the middle. Eager to share the small adventure with her.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「ヤスい服でも気持ちが大事」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho — your dad said that it doesn't matter if your clothes are cheap — what matters is your heart.
lines.style: Reflective, holding something important. Slow, deliberate pace. Repeating his father's wisdom like it mattered to him too. Trailing warmth.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとサッカーのキラーパスの動画観たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — Dad and I watched a video of an amazing soccer pass today.
lines.style: Animated, eager to share. Quick, energetic opening. Small excitement rippling through. Waiting for her to understand why it mattered.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「ドタバタコメディはストレス発散」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho — your dad said that slapstick comedy helps him let off steam.
lines.style: Quiet understanding in the voice. Soft delivery. Passing along something intimate he overheard or was told. Gentle close.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと花火の「バーン」って音を聞いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — I heard fireworks going 'boom' with Dad today.
lines.style: Bright, wonder-struck closing. Soft opening, building slightly. The onomatopoeia lands with innocent delight. Warm, satisfied finish.
